races.display_title: Happy 96th Birthday John Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: SPARTAN TIMES is still unexposed as a hurdler and looks well-in based on his recent Flat exploits, so he makes plenty of appeal. Jolie Coeur Allen wasn't beaten far over C&D on his most recent outing and should go well again with Charlie Maggs a positive jockey booking. Recent winner Cawthorne Cracker is also respected. SPARTAN TIMES JOLIE COEUR ALLEN (FR) CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE)

races.display_title: Roxyfet Sports Lounge For Private Hire Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: STEEL RAVEN has been progressing well since upped to 1¼m+ on the Flat and appeals as the type to take well to hurdling. He's preferred to Jerseygeordie , who made much more impact tried over hurdles than in a handful of starts on all-weather for Jamie Osborne when third at Newton Abbot last month, form which has already been franked by the first 2. Watcha Snoop may prove best of the rest. STEEL RAVEN (IRE) JERSEYGEORDIE WATCHA SNOOP (IRE)

races.display_title: Fairlight Studios Cafe At Sedgefield Racecourse Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CLOSE HOUSE showed plenty in what is usually a warm race at Ayr back in the spring and is a straightforward choice to get off the mark at the second time of asking. Red Shea was no match for a useful prospect at Cork last month but kept on to pull clear of the remainder and should at least give the selection something to think about if coping with the sharper test. Lower De Couely , an easy winner on her sole outing in Irish points, shouldn't be overlooked in the betting, either. CLOSE HOUSE (IRE) RED SHEA (IRE) LOWER DE COUELY (FR)

races.verdict: Sole 3-y-o LEOPARDS ROCK can trump his much more exposed rivals with a return to further likely to bring more improvement. Empirestateofmind was only just denied the follow up at Hamilton 9 days ago so is feared most ahead of Arkenstaar , who arrives fresh after a light campaign. LEOPARDS ROCK EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE) ARKENSTAAR

races.verdict: Course winner ASHEN was clear of the rest when a good second at Hamilton last week and should appreciate the return to this longer trip. He gets the nod. Recent Hamilton scorer Belsito is feared most, whilst market strength behind the lightly-raced Big Harry again could prove significant. ASHEN (IRE) BELSITO (GER) BIG HARRY

races.verdict: SOUTH SHORE continues to thrive for his current yard and his latest win at Sandown looks rock solid given what the re-opposing Maharajas Express has since achieved. Brave Nation completes the shortlist having made a bright start for Michael Attwater. SOUTH SHORE MAHARAJAS EXPRESS BRAVE NATION (IRE)
